summary: Merged origin/master into feat/evaluation-rebuild (113 commits, needed to unblock a real migration mismatch blocking a live eval rerun) and fixed the fallout of master's workspace->unit rename (0058_unit_rename, e2092ecd) landing on code and corpus data this branch had written before the rename existed.
details: Root need: the branch's local Alembic chain stopped at 0056_speech_trigger_state while the live DB (and origin/master) was at 0058_unit_rename -- StartupError on every eval case. Merging master was the only way to get the missing migrations without hand-authoring them.

Conflict resolution: composition.py combined HEAD's injected clock (clock=clock) with master's unit_of/convo.unit rename -- both were real, independent changes to the same DecisionLogRecorder call. design/09-decision-index.md's two conflicts took HEAD's newer prose (a tracing-rebuild narrowing note master never saw) with master's rename mechanically reapplied on top. 6 modify/delete conflicts on the already-superseded old eval driver (evals/note_candidates.py, evals/proactive.py, evals/run.py, and their tests) kept the deletion -- master's only changes to them were the same mechanical rename, moot once the files are gone.

Real fallout found post-merge (make typecheck/test caught none of it live -- pyright's own live diagnostics lagged badly mid-merge and had to be cross-checked against mypy): SqlNoteStore.create()/append_revision()/standing() call sites in nora/subject/knowledge.py, nora/subject/proactive.py (x2), and nora/subject/dreaming.py still passed workspace= where the renamed signature takes unit=. evals/backbone.py's and evals/rebuilt/runner.py's policy-template isolation substitution still searched for the literal `workspace = "..."` TOML key, silently no-opping now that Conversation.unit made policy.toml's own key `unit = "..."` -- would have reintroduced the exact live 'workspace names no home room' bug this branch already fixed once, this time via the rename rather than a missing rewrite.

Corpus data fallout: evals/corpora/{note_candidates,proactive_act,proactive_decide}.yaml's 44 embedded policy-TOML `workspace = "..."` lines renamed to `unit = "..."` (Policy.Conversation has extra="forbid", so the stale key would hard-fail load_policy at drive time). One case (proactive_decide.yaml's d08) had been ported under its pre-rename name (d08_empty_workspace) and was invisibly the same case as master's renamed d08_empty_unit -- name aligned, not duplicated.

Test fixtures with the same hardcoded workspace = "..." literal fixed to match: tests/unit/test_eval_backbone.py, tests/integration/test_the_rebuilt_suite_runs.py (one of these fixtures' staleness would have made an INDUCED-error test pass for the wrong reason -- a validation crash on an unrecognised policy key, not the structural case it was written to induce).
Full suite after merge + fixes: 8056 passed (up from 7969 pre-merge plus master's own net test growth), 0 failed. make lint/typecheck/imports/release-check all clean.
